title: Skill, Script, and Hook Activation Repair
brief: Repair the activation and registry layer so high-value converted assets can actually load and be discovered. Reconcile runtime, docs, and shell layers.

units.title: Build skill-reconcile script to repair orphan, phantom, and polluted trigger mappings
Build script-census and script-registry-sync scripts to align real script surface with public index
Build one bundle resolver for task-based loading with deterministic activation order
Reconcile TypeScript hooks, shell hooks, and documented hooks via one truth-sync pass
Build route/action contract gate for capability claims with early failure on drift

exit_conditions: Script catalog truth matches real script surface
Hook truth reconciled across docs, runtime, and shell
notes: Injection target: Phase 13 (Final Wiring + Web UI). Must complete before Phase 13 finalizes UI wiring.
